rules: A new master or stem upload is never canonical merely because it exists.
Capture exact filename, file hash, source/provenance, BPM when known, prompt/source relation, family/variant relation and whether a stem folder exists.
The complete master is Ground Truth.
New stems default to source-only until individually listening-certified.
Human-selected promotion updates the one canonical jukebox.json; do not create a parallel registry.
Site intake may persist privately through KFB Production Control. GitHub promotion is a separate explicit checkpoint.

naming.master: Keep human-authored filename stable once review begins.
naming.alternate: Use family + variant metadata; do not overwrite a different render.
